name: Shipping Schedule
summary: At Jerod's Landing, the Defias Brotherhood sends contraband along Elwynn's waterways. Its dockmaster guards a schedule of shipments between Redridge and Westfall, and SI:7 wants it.

sections.title: Smuggling at Jerod's Landing
sections.body: South of Goldshire, Jerod's Landing lies on the Elwynn bank of the Nazferiti River. The Defias Brotherhood seized it as a hub for river traffic. From there, they carry contraband between Redridge and Westfall by waterways beyond the Stormwind Guard's notice. Their dockmaster keeps the Shipping Schedule close, recording each shipment.

sections.title: In the Crosshairs of SI:7
sections.body: Master Mathias Shaw leads SI:7, Stormwind's intelligence agency, and ordered the schedule stolen. It can reveal Defias supply lines, and taking it tests new operatives. The theft must happen inside the dock house, from the dockmaster's pockets. If the operative is caught, SI:7 denies any connection. No trail leads back to its barracks in Stormwind.

faq.answer: The Shipping Schedule records contraband shipments handled by the Defias Brotherhood dockmaster at Jerod's Landing. It tracks cargo carried between Redridge and Westfall through Elwynn Forest's inland waters.
Master Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7, wants the schedule recovered. He uses it to track Defias smuggling and test promising rogues in the field.

The Defias Dockmaster carries the schedule inside the dock house at Jerod's Landing. The landing lies on the Nazferiti River south of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest, and the document must be taken from him there.

faq.q: What is Jerod's Landing used for?
aliases: why do defias have jerods landing
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood seized Jerod's Landing as a transit point for smuggling. Its river access links their operations in Redridge with their strongholds in Westfall.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can test the stealth and pickpocketing SI:7 expects of operatives seeking to join its ranks by taking the schedule from the dockmaster's pockets.
